articles.title: Letter: Support the Pet Adoption Fair
body: To the editor: I have lived on Fox Court for 24 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foxglove Heights Neighbors has made. Please keep the pet adoption fair in the budget. Many of us on Fox Court use it every week.
